verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes supports running arbitrary commands/custom images in isolated containers (any dependency, custom images) and JS/Go SDKs exist alongside Python, implying multi-language support, but evidence never explicitly demonstrates executing Python vs JavaScript code side-by-side or shows 'rich results' (structured output, plots, rendered artifacts) being returned from execution. missing for 10: explicit multi-language execution examples (e.g., running Python and JS snippets in the same workflow), documentation of rich/structured result formats (images, dataframes, exceptions) returned from sandbox runs, independent confirmation of language-agnostic execution beyond shell commands.
